title: Enter the ballot – TCS London Marathon
claims: The public ballot draws winners at random and everyone has the same chance of success.

UK residents who donate their entry fee during the ballot are automatically entered into a second ballot, which at least doubles their chance; a successful either-ballot place reduces the entry fee from £69.99 to £49.99.
UK residents who do not opt to donate pay the full £69.99 if drawn.
Entrants unsuccessful in both ballots who donated receive a premium winter running top (retail about £60); ballot results are emailed to all entrants in July.
